testcase.name: the claymore is a placed proximity device, not something you throw
definitions reject impossible numbers rather than storing them
utility wire ids occupy their own range, clear of guns and melee
the catalogue matches the mechanics §6 table exactly
wire ids round-trip, and foreign ids decode to null rather than guessing
only the claymore is provisional; the plan specifies everything else
damage-over-time utilities report a damage rate, instant ones report none
the wire encoding is frozen: appending must never shift an existing id
vision-blocking and persistence are properties of the effect, not of the item
every utility has a definition, and the registry hands out the same instance
